The video begins with a red, white, and blue patriotic graphic design which transitions to a screen that includes the text "LWV" with the words, "League of Women Voters of Portland" written below. Next, there is an outline of Oregon with the state's name overlaid on top of it, alongside an American flag and stars. The imagery includes the words "VOTE" and "DEMOCRACY" along the bottom of the screen. The scene then changes to a red screen with a star in the center with the words "ELECTION 2020" next to it. Finally, the screen reads "Video Voters' Guide - Election 2020 - Candidate Portland City Commissioner Position 2 - Julia DeGraw."

The video cuts to a woman with short white hair, wearing glasses, a light green turtleneck, and a black blazer. She is speaking directly to the camera, introducing herself as Colleen Shoemaker of the League of Women Voters of Portland. There is an indoor setting behind her; a blue vase with red berries and a green plant. A dining room table is also visible.
The screen then cuts to a split screen of both women, Colleen Shoemaker (mentioned above) and Julia DeGraw. DeGraw has auburn hair and wears a dark patterned shirt. Colleen Shoemaker then begins to ask DeGraw questions.
